why: Header, Menu and Footer each live in their own file under src/components/, re-exported by components/index.js, and App.jsx does 'import { Header, Menu, Footer } from './components'' and renders all three in a fragment. One import line for three components, and the files sit one folder down, but each component lives in a file and App renders all three (the page shows all three).

step.title: Render Header, Menu and Footer in App
step.instructions: In src/App.jsx, import Header, Menu and Footer from their files and render all three inside a fragment.

checks.label: App renders Header, Menu and Footer

hints: Each component file ends with export default <Name>.
common_mistakes: Defining all three components inside App.jsx instead of in their own files.

files.food-truck/src/components/index.js:
export { Header } from './Header'
export { Menu } from './Menu'
export { Footer } from './Footer'
